fields.name: Rawsonville Bridge
fields.description: Primary monitoring point near Rawsonville town bridge. Measures upstream influence of agricultural runoff from Hex River Valley.

fields.name: Villiersdorp Reservoir Outlet
fields.description: Monitoring point below Theewaterskloof Dam outlet. Key indicator of reservoir water quality and flow regulation impacts.

fields.name: Worcester Weir
fields.description: Urban monitoring point within Worcester. Captures impact of municipal water treatment discharge and urban stormwater.

fields.name: Swellendam Confluence
fields.description: Downstream monitoring site near Swellendam. Captures cumulative agricultural and urban inputs from the upper Breede catchment.

fields.name: Bonnievale Bridge
fields.description: Mid-catchment site near Bonnievale. Important for tracking wine and fruit farming irrigation return flows.

fields.name: Wemmershoek Dam Outlet
fields.description: Monitoring point below Wemmershoek Dam. Primary water supply source for Cape Town — critical baseline quality indicator.

fields.name: Paarl Bridge
fields.description: Urban monitoring point in Paarl. Measures impact of urban expansion, viticulture runoff, and informal settlement stormwater.

fields.name: Franschhoek Tributary Junction
fields.description: Junction where Franschhoek tributary meets the Berg River. Key point for monitoring wine estate and tourism industry impacts.

fields.name: Hermon Gauging Station
fields.description: Existing DWS gauging station near Hermon. Long-term flow and quality reference point for the middle Berg catchment.

fields.name: Misverstand Dam Inlet
fields.description: Lower Berg monitoring point at Misverstand Dam inlet. Captures cumulative catchment quality before storage for irrigation use.
